cw721_address.description:
Existing CW721 (e.g. cw721-svg) address where this minter is authorized.
If None, admin must call `LinkCollection` before mint.

max_tokens.description: Hard supply cap. Oracle/sudo can NEVER increase this.

proceeds.description: Address that receives mint proceeds (defaults to owner).

token_uri_prefix.description: Base token URI / template prefix (collection-specific; optional).

definitions.description: Config snapshot for a minter that gates on loyalty eligibility.

root.description: 32-byte merkle root as lowercase hex (empty if not set).

definitions.name: hm_nft_oracle_PricePolicy
definitions.description: Admin / instantiate price policy.

algo.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this algo.

asset_id.description: Optional asset filter when decoding JSON price payloads (`asset` field).

bps_band.description:
Half-width band in basis points around mid. 0 = exact mid only.
Payment must satisfy mid * (1 - bps/10000) ..= mid * (1 + bps/10000).

chain_uid.description: Optional filter: only accept sudo for this chain_uid.

fallback_unit_price.description: When oracle disabled or mid absent: fixed unit price in `denom` microunits.

max_staleness_seconds.description: Fail closed when mid is older than this many seconds (vs `env.block.time`).

usd_to_unit_scale.description:
If attestation has `price_usd` (decimal string) and no direct mid,
mid = round(price_usd * usd_to_unit_scale). Demo FX only.

definitions.description: How the minter obtains price mids.

admin_sync.description: Mode C: admin ExecuteMsg sync (demo fallback only).

query.description: Mode B: pull/query another store (stub for frameworks; not required in v0 minter).

sudo.description: Mode A: x/hashmerchant sudo push (preferred long-term).

cw_ownable_Action
definitions.description: Actions that can be taken to alter the contract's ownership

accept_ownership.description:
Accept the pending ownership transfer.

Can only be called by the pending owner.

renounce_ownership.description:
Give up the contract's ownership and the possibility of appointing
a new owner.

Can only be invoked by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is canceled.

transfer_ownership.description:
Propose to transfer the contract's ownership to another account,
optionally with an expiry time.

Can only be called by the contract's current owner.

Any existing pending ownership transfer is overwritten.

definitions.name: cw_utils_expiration_Expiration
definitions.description:
Expiration represents a point in time when some event happens.
It can compare with a BlockInfo and will return is_expired() == true
once the condition is hit (and for every block in the future)

never.description: Never will never expire. Used to express the empty variant

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

value.description: Opaque value bytes; price demos use JSON UTF-8.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_addresses_Addr
definitions.description:
A human-readable address.

In Cosmos, this is typically bech32 encoded. But for multichain smart contracts no
assumptions should be made other than being UTF-8 encoded and of reasonable length.

This type represents a validated address. It can be created in the following ways
1. Use `Addr::unchecked(input)`
2. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_validate(input)?`
3. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_humanize(canonical_addr)?`
4. Deserialize from JSON. This must only be done from JSON that was validated before
such as a contract's state. `Addr` must not be used in messages sent by the user
because this would result in unvalidated instances.

This type is immutable. If you really need to mutate it (Really? Are you sure?), create
a mutable copy using `let mut mutable = Addr::to_string()` and operate on that `String`
instance.

definitions.name: cw_ownable_Ownership_cosmwasm_std_addresses_Addr_
definitions.description: The contract's ownership info

owner.description:
The contract's current owner.
`None` if the ownership has been renounced.

pending_expiry.description:
The deadline for the pending owner to accept the ownership.
`None` if there isn't a pending ownership transfer, or if a transfer
exists and it doesn't have a deadline.

pending_owner.description:
The account who has been proposed to take over the ownership.
`None` if there isn't a pending ownership transfer.
